prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Restore Notice: Add a prominent account recovery hint warning users to sign in with their original provider to prevent blank profile resets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after users signed in again with a different account.)
1: [home, wait_info] Live Desktop Environment Ready Check: Show an active status checklist and visual progress bar while preparing desktop pet overlay files on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, and support logged 3 reports of pets failing to show on the desktop.)
2: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Pet First Launch Intro: Redesign the home intro screen into a stage layout featuring live pet animations, sound effects, and direct desktop launch button. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% with long completion time (mean 5815s) and confusion on first launch.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Grid Layout Path Choice Screen: Display path choices in a structured grid layout with mascot badges and estimated setup completion times. (why: choose_path step shows high mean duration (514s), indicating hesitation during selection.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Tray Notification Screen: Add a dedicated explanation screen showing how to access, control, and hide the pet via the system tray menu. (why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.)
5: [adoption, copy] Certificate Naming Prompt Incentive: Update adoption certificate copy with personalized naming cues and official pet adoption stamp button text. (why: Adoption step has a 60.9% conversion rate; reinforcing pet ownership boosts completion rates.)
6: [choose_path, new_flow] Companion Quiz Recommendation Flow: Add a companion quiz screen before path selection to automatically recommend the optimal adoption route. (why: High mean time on choose_path (514s) indicates choice paralysis; a quiz streamlines decision making.)
